config.epoch_mode: reset only; carry is out of scope (Q7)
config.closed: exactly the listed parameters per family; each convention parameter accepts exactly its single v1 value; any other value is INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION; missing or extra parameter is INVALID_CONFIG

numeric_policy.rule: R17 policy: local Decimal context prec 120, ROUND_HALF_EVEN, Emin -999999, Emax 999999, traps as in _indicators.py; exact Fraction seeds; one final float64 conversion; fixture exact values are REFERENCE values
numeric_policy.tolerance: abs(y-r) <= max(8*ulp(r), 1e-12*abs(r)), r = float(exact reference); source docs/api/INTRADAY.md numeric error contract
numeric_policy.exact_zero: reference 0 must publish +0.0 when guaranteeable; guarantees: identical epoch closes (MACD), signal_period 1 (histogram), exactly zero decimal numerators or sums (DMI, stochastic); otherwise zero_bound: abs(y) <= 1e-12 * max epoch close price

roles.contract: unchanged R17 supplied BAR chunks (None = absent delivery; empty tuple = observed-empty delivery); no new fixed role, no new DataKind

reused_unchanged.anchored_closes: exact closes a..t; feeds MACD fast chain and slow chain (independent); the signal consumes the ordered MACD observations derived from them, not a preparation family
reused_unchanged.true_ranges: TR[a+1..t]; feeds the DMI TR/DM smoothing chain
reused_unchanged.high_extrema: window max at the target; the stochastic/Williams run at its last element equals this operand for the same n
reused_unchanged.low_extrema: window min at the target; same as above

not_consumed: published Float64 intraday.ema, intraday.atr (rounded witnesses; only their exact unrounded mathematics is shared)

additive_internal_families.directional_moves: (+DM[k], -DM[k]) for k=a+1..t; needs high, low on slots a..t; unit currency/share
additive_internal_families.rolling_extrema_runs: (HH[j], LL[j], C[j]) for j in a consecutive run of target-ending positions of one window length n; needs high, low per window slot and close on the run slots

mathematics.notation: slots are governed epoch positions k=0..T-1 (k=0 is the anchor a, k=T-1 is the target t); C,H,L exact rational prices (coefficient/10^scale); all values exact rational

macd.ema: E_p[p-1]=mean(C[0..p-1]); E_p[k]=(2*C[k]+(p-1)*E_p[k-1])/(p+1) for k>=p; defined for k>=p-1; identical to the exact unrounded value behind R17 intraday.ema with period p over the same context
macd.line: M[k]=E_fast[k]-E_slow[k] for k>=slow-1 (fast and slow chains independent; fast period < slow period)
macd.signal: G[slow+g-2]=mean(M[slow-1..slow+g-2]); G[k]=(2*M[k]+(g-1)*G[k-1])/(g+1) for k>=slow+g-1; defined for k>=slow+g-2
macd.degenerate: g=1: G=M and histogram is exactly 0; fast=1: E_1=C

dmi.movements: up[k]=H[k]-H[k-1]; dn[k]=L[k-1]-L[k]; +DM[k]=up if (up>dn and up>0) else 0; -DM[k]=dn if (dn>up and dn>0) else 0 (ties and zero moves give 0)
dmi.smoothing: for x in {TR,+DM,-DM}: S[n]=mean(x[1..n]); S[k]=((n-1)*S[k-1]+x[k])/n, n=di_period, defined k>=n; S_TR equals the exact value behind R17 intraday.atr(n)
dmi.dx: DX[k]=100*|+DI-(-DI)|/(+DI+(-DI)) = 100*|S_+DM-S_-DM|/(S_+DM+S_-DM); undefined iff DI undefined or S_+DM+S_-DM=0
dmi.adx: f=first k>=n with DX defined; ADX[f+m-1]=mean(DX[f..f+m-1]), m=adx_period; ADX[k]=((m-1)*ADX[k-1]+DX[k])/m
dmi.monotonicity: S_TR>0 and S_+DM+S_-DM>0 persist once true (exact positive weights), so undefined states are a prefix of the epoch only

stochastic.window: HH[j]=max(H[j-n+1..j]), LL[j]=min(L[j-n+1..j]), j>=n-1, n=k_period; all slots inside the epoch
stochastic.k: K[j]=mean(R[j-s+1..j]), s=k_slowing, j>=n+s-2; undefined if any contributor undefined
stochastic.d: D[j]=mean(K[j-d+1..j]), d=d_period, j>=n+s+d-3; undefined if any contributor undefined

mathematics.publication: value = float64(exact rational) with round-half-even; zero published as +0.0 (never -0.0); implementations compute with the R17 Decimal120 policy and are accepted per the fixture acceptance rule

dependency_fields.dmi_*: close, high, low on epoch slots a..t-1; high, low on the target (if t>a); if t=a only the anchor slot (close, high, low)
dependency_fields.stoch_d: high, low on the last k+s+d-2 epoch slots; close on the last s+d-1 of them
dependency_fields.stoch_k: high, low on the last k+s-1 epoch slots; close on the last s
dependency_fields.williams_r: high, low on the last k epoch slots; close on the last one

decisions_proposed.text: Seed each EMA chain with the simple mean of its first p epoch closes (R17 convention). Alternatives: first close as seed (no warm-up); longer history seeding.
Signal seeded with the simple mean of the first g MACD observations (first observation at the slow seed bar). Alternatives: first MACD value as seed; signal seeded from the fast seed bar.
MACD line exists only from the slow seed bar; the fast chain runs from its own seed meanwhile.
alpha=2/(p+1) for MACD and signal (not Wilder 1/p).
Wilder smoothing in average form seeded by the mean of the first n values (same as R17 ATR). Equivalent sum form gives identical DI/DX. Alternatives: EMA alpha=2/(n+1); SMA windows.
Strict inequality with zero on ties; zero moves are not movements. Both DM zero for inside bars and equal moves.
DI, DX, ADX published as points on 0..100 with unit DMI points. Alternative: fraction 0..1.
DI undefined when smoothed TR is 0; DX undefined when smoothed +DM plus -DM is 0: not_applicable/zero_denominator. Alternatives: publish 0; carry previous value.

ADX seeds with the mean of the first adx_period defined DX values starting at the first defined DX, then Wilder recursion; warm-up is therefore data dependent when DX starts late. Alternatives: fixed seed index with poisoning; undefined DX treated as 0.
Two explicit parameters di_period and adx_period; no default.

Raw %K location in the n-bar window including the current bar; %K = simple mean of s raw values (slowing); %D = simple mean of d %K values. s=1 is fast %K. Alternatives: EMA or Wilder smoothing; %D on raw.
Stochastic 0..100 points; Williams %R -100..0 points. Alternative: fractions.

HH=LL makes raw %K and Williams undefined (not_applicable/zero_denominator) and the condition propagates to every smoothed output that consumes it. Alternatives: neutral 50 (R17 RSI precedent); 0; carry previous.
Uses k_period and the same window as raw %K; no separate period parameter.
SUPERSEDED by ruling Q2: implementation uses R17 Decimal120 recurrences and tolerance; exact rationals are fixture reference values only.
One homogeneous config per family (macd, dmi, stochastic); caller may select any subset of that family's IDs (R17 selection style, not the EF1 fixed complete set).
Every chain and window lies inside [anchor, target]; rolling windows cannot reach before the anchor; older bars and old gaps never count (R17 band precedent).
intraday.macd_line/signal/histogram (currency/share); intraday.plus_di/minus_di/dx/adx (DMI points); intraday.stoch_k/stoch_d (stochastic points); intraday.williams_r (Williams %R points).
Batch snapshot and full supplied-history replay only; update, restore, merge unsupported (R17 posture).

open_questions.text: Extend packages/intraday (equity_features_intraday) with additive modules, a new prerelease version and a new catalog digest. The money-flow contract B uses the same package.

Implementation follows the R17 policy (Decimal120 recurrences, ROUND_HALF_EVEN, one final float64 conversion, tolerance abs(y-r) <= max(8*ulp(r), 1e-12*abs(r)) from docs/api/INTRADAY.md; kernel in _indicators.py). Fixture exact fractions and float.hex are REFERENCE values. Reference 0 must be +0.0 where guaranteeable (see acceptance rules) else abs(y) <= 1e-12 * max epoch close.
As proposed: first defined DX, data-dependent warm-up.
DMI points, stochastic points, Williams %R points accepted as additive units, to be listed in the later shared-contract header ledger and unit amendment (a sibling document after freeze).

Verified: packages/contracts validation.py validate_batch refuses low > high and open/high/low/close outside [low, high] with INVALID_SCHEMA (zero-volume rows must be null OHLC). The producer adds no check, no new code, no change to shared validators.
update, restore, merge and carry epochs are NOT in v1. Anchored batch (reset epoch) only; a carry-mode context is INVALID_CONFIG.
No default periods or thresholds; standard values appear only in fixtures.
directional_moves and rolling_extrema_runs accepted as additive internal families.
REQUIRED: the output at bar n must not depend on later bars. Fixtures P01 (macd), P02 (dmi), P03 (stochastic).
Not a contract item in v1 beyond O(1) state per bar and no whole-series barrier; measurement belongs to the release baseline.

fixture_notation.compact: NOT canonical wire. slots are global indices 0..T-1; target is the last slot; anchor is the epoch start; h,l,c are integer coefficients at scale; null means no value; defect kinds: missing (no row), empty (observed empty), null (listed fields null), future (known after K), unknown (known_at null); absent_columns lists columns missing from the whole delivery; delivery none means batches=None; all other slots are complete, causal, positive-volume rows
fixture_notation.expected: value.exact is the exact rational; value.float64 and value.hex are the correctly rounded result; expected/observed are quality counts; evidence_rows lists [slot, use] sorted by feature id then slot after truncation to evidence_limit (default 10000)
fixture_notation.intermediate_exact: optional exact chains for hand checking
